senses.gloss: to crush (olives), to pound, beat Shebi. IV, 9 כּוֹתֵש וסך וכ׳ he may crush olives and use the oil for ointment in the field.
units: Sabb. 74ᵃ וליחשוב נמי כותש let the Mishnah (Sabb. VII, 2) count (among the forbidden labors) also pounding (grain), v. כְּתִישָׁה.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:4">Men. VIII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 86a">86ᵃ</cite>), Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 8; Pesik. Par., p. 40ᵃ <he>וכוֹתְשִׁין אותה</he> and pound it (the burnt body).
Koh. R. to VII, 2 ולמה כותשין על הלב why do mourners beat their hearts?; a. e.—Part. pass. כָּתוּשׁ, f. כְּתוּשָׁה crushed.
Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵃ top, v. חָרַף.—2) to press, to be closely joined, grouped; שער כּוֹתֵשׁ a thick hair crown, i.e. ramifications forming a sort of arbor.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:3">Peah II, 3</cite> <he>אם היה ש׳ כ׳</he> if the ramifications are intertwined; Y. ib. 17ᵃ top [read:] <he>מה כ׳ כעלי במכתש וכ׳</he> (v. R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:3">Kil. V, 3</cite>) what does this <cite ref="K00438"><he>כותש</he></cite> mean? Does it mean, like the pestle in the mortar (i.e. the partition is formed by a depression in the ground between the two fields, out of which the fence rises), or does it mean, pressing upon (overgrowing) the fence? Answ. <he>מן מה דתנינן סער כותש ואין הגדר כותש וכ׳</he> reading as we do ‘the hair (ramification) presses’, and not ‘the fence presses’, it is evident that it means ‘overgrowing the fence.’

senses.gloss: to be crushed, pounded. Tanḥ. Ki Thabo 3 מה השמן הזה נ׳ וכ׳ as oil is pounded, and the more it is pounded, the better it becomes, v. כְּתִישָׁה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 1:8">Ter. I, 8</cite> <he>זתים הנִכְתָּשִׁין</he> crushed olives.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 3:14">Tosef. ib. III, 14</cite> <he>עתידין לִיכָּתֵשׁ</he> designated for pounding; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 2:5">Tosef. Ohol. II, 5</cite> some ed. (oth. <he>מְכוּתֶּתֶת</he>, ed. Zuck. <he>מכתתת</he>; Y. Naz. VIII, 56ᶜ <he>מְכוּתָּתִין</he>).

senses.gloss: [to come in contact with,] to wrestle, fight (cmp. גָּשַׁש). Y. Peah IV, 18ᵇ top שנים שהיו מִתְכַּתְּשִׁין וכ׳ if two persons were fighting about a (forgotten) sheaf; Tosef. Peah II, 2 מִכַּתְּשִׁין ed. Zuck. (Var. מתכשין, corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 37:11">Sifré Deut. 37</cite> <he>ד׳ מלכיות מִתְכַּתְּשׁוֹת וכ׳</he> (ed. Fr. <he>מתכחשות</he>) four governments disputed about it (each naming it differently); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 743:14">Yalk. Num. 743</cite> <he>מתרחשות</he> (corr. acc.); Pesik. Zutr. Deut. ed. Bub. p. 9 <he>מלכים מִתְכַּתְּשִׁין …</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 743:14">ib.</cite> p. 30 <he>מתכבש׳</he> (corr. acc.).
